notes.title: Those Who Crawl 1.2.4
notes.notes:
This is a small fix for the "Speed Crawl" achievement.
The achievement should now be fully completable during an uninterrupted play-through.

notes.title: Free tense horror game Those Who Crawl about exploring shrinking caves added Linux / Steam Deck support
notes.notes:
Originally released in 2022, Hush Fin Games have upgraded the free game Those Who Crawl, which now includes Linux and Steam Deck support.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/01/free-tense-horror-game-those-who-crawl-about-exploring-shrinking-caves-added-linux-steam-deck-support/

notes.title: Those Who Crawl 1.2
notes.notes:
As part of our effort to port Those Who Crawl to VR, we've brought some content and quality-of-life updates to Those Who Crawl.

In 1.2, you'll find full controller support, Linux and Steamdeck support, new languages, as well as new art and content. We're very grateful for all the kind words over the two years since this project's release. The VR port is coming soon too, so keep an eye out for that!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3421130/Those_Who_Crawl_VR/

[h2]Changelist[/h2]
[list]
[*] Two new areas
[*] Full story rework
[*] Improved visuals
[*] Improved movement control
[*] Controller support
[*] Language support for French, Spanish, German, and Russian
[*] Linux and Steamdeck support
[*] New Menus
[*] Small Bug Fixes...
[/list]
